raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

Loading cached KV can cost more than recomputing it. Let deployments choose using measured costs.

## Modifications

Add optional `--lmcache-load-cost-profile`. Match the model, parallel size, chunk size, prompt length, common local prefix and actual external hit length. Skip loading only when measured recomputation saves at least the configured margin (default 5%). Unmeasured shapes keep loading.

Add `--lmcache-min-retrieve-tokens` (default 0). Keep rank decisions consistent, release skipped-load locks, and still store recomputed KV. Profiles load once at startup; both options preserve existing behavior by default. PD use requires #47507; includes #47558.

## Accuracy Tests

MI355X / ROCm 10 TP=2 SHM tests passed partial-hit rejection, recompute/store/reuse, unknown-shape loading and salt isolation with exact 8-token outputs. Integrated PD tests passed rejection followed by acceptance after both-server restart, matching 16 baseline tokens. Combined integration a1477798 passed 459 tests and 262 subtests. After merging main at 41f8cbb7cc, CPU regression with the test-only fix #47564 passed 441 tests and 214 subtests on ROCm. Without #47564, its four known Muse Spark subtests fail. Hosted CI is pending.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

At 0c10512e, Qwen3-0.6B TP=1, concurrency 1/output 8, non-lazy 64 GiB L1: 1824 calibration/validation requests passed output and hit checks. Held-out inline mean request time fell from 300.08 to 216.91 ms (27.7%); SHM stayed near 99 ms. Profiles are specific to the measured workload and require recalibration when it changes.

 ```
 
 For full LMCache config options see https://docs.lmcache.ai/api_reference/configurations.html.
+
+## Avoid loading small external hits
+
+Use `--lmcache-min-retrieve-tokens N` to recompute external hits shorter than
+`N` tokens. The default is `0`, preserving existing loading behavior. This is
+an operator-calibrated threshold, not an online cost estimator: compare loading
+and recomputation on the deployed model, hardware, KV dtype, storage tier and
+workload before choosing it.
+
+SGLang skips the lookup when even a fully cached prompt cannot reach the
+threshold. Otherwise it looks up normally and applies the threshold to the
+external tokens beyond the common rank-local GPU prefix. A rejected hit
+releases all lookup locks before GPU allocation or transfer. The local GPU
+prefix remains reusable and storing computed KV remains enabled.
+
+For example, with `--lmcache-min-retrieve-tokens 512`, a 256-token external hit
+is recomputed; a 512-token external hit can be loaded. A 768-token total hit
+with 512 tokens already resident in the engine counts as only 256 external
+tokens. Long prompts with short partial hits may still incur storage prefetch
+cost before SGLang can decide. Recalibrate after deployment changes and check
+held-out mixed-hit latency and throughput; fewer transfers alone do not prove
+a performance improvement.
+
+Run the manual GPU test to check lookup bypass, rejection of a short partial
+hit on a longer prompt, and successful reuse of KV stored after recomputation:
+
+```bash
+SGLANG_TEST_LMCACHE_TP_SIZE=2 \
+  python test/manual/mem_cache/test_lmcache_load_admission.py -v
+```
+
+The default is TP=1. The test owns its daemon and engine, uses engine-driven
+transfers, and requires LMCache in the active Python environment. Override
+`SGLANG_TEST_LMCACHE_MODEL` or `SGLANG_TEST_LMCACHE_BASE_PORT` (default `31700`)
+to select the model or the four consecutive ports used by the test.
+
+Set `SGLANG_TEST_LMCACHE_SHM=1` to run the same checks with a named, non-lazy
+SHM pool. The daemon and workers must share `/dev/shm`. Calibrate the threshold
+using the actual transfer path; inline and SHM can have different break-even
+points.
+
+## Decide from measured costs
+
+Pass `--lmcache-load-cost-profile costs.json` to compare measured loading and
+recomputation costs after lookup. The default is unset. The minimum-token
+gate still applies independently. Profile decisions use the actual external
+hit beyond the common rank-local prefix, before GPU allocation or transfer.
+Declined hits follow the same lock-release and store lifecycle as the minimum
+gate. No request-time file reads or additional collectives are needed.
+
+For example, these **illustrative costs are not deployment measurements**:
+
+```json
+{
+  "version": 1,
+  "metric": "request_elapsed_ms",
+  "min_savings": 0.05,
+  "calibration": "Replace with measurements on the deployed configuration",
+  "profiles": [{
+    "model_name": "my-model",
+    "world_size": 1,
+    "chunk_size": 256,
+    "lookup_tokens": 1024,
+    "engine_computed_tokens": 256,
+    "external_tokens": 512,
+    "load_ms": 10.0,
+    "recompute_ms": 8.0
+  }]
+}
+```
+
+Only an exact match of all six geometry fields uses a measurement. The model
+name must match SGLang's model path, and world size is TP times PP. Lookup
+tokens are the page-aligned prefix queried by SGLang, excluding the protected
+tail; they can differ from the full input length. External tokens count the
+actual hit beyond the common engine prefix, including for partial hits.
+Unmeasured shapes keep normal loading behavior. There is no interpolation.
+
+The default saving margin is 5%: recomputation must be cheaper by at least
+that fraction before declining. Costs must be positive and finite. Invalid
+schemas, duplicate shapes and invalid margins fail at startup. Supported
+metric labels are `ttft_ms`, `request_elapsed_ms` and `wave_elapsed_ms`;
+the chosen label describes the supplied costs, not an online measurement or
+learning mechanism. A TTFT improvement can reduce throughput.
+
+Calibrate both branches with the same external keys and already-issued lookup
+path, then validate on separate requests. A run that bypasses lookup using a
+large minimum-token gate does not measure post-lookup recomputation cost.
+Keep hardware, KV dtype, transfer mode, storage, concurrency, output length and
+engine settings fixed. These deployment properties are not inferred from the
+file; choose a matching profile and recalibrate when they change.
+
+Set `SGLANG_TEST_LMCACHE_COST_PROFILE=1` in the manual admission test above to
+exercise synthetic measured accept/decline decisions and an unmeasured shape,
+including the partial-hit recompute/store/reuse path. This checks correctness;
+the synthetic costs are not suitable for performance tuning.

+"""Measured costs for exact LMCache request shapes; no request-time I/O."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+import math
+from dataclasses import dataclass, fields
+from pathlib import Path
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class LoadCostKey:
+    model_name: str
+    world_size: int
+    chunk_size: int
+    lookup_tokens: int
+    engine_computed_tokens: int
+    external_tokens: int
+
+
+def _number(value: object, name: str) -> float:
+    if type(value) not in (int, float):
+        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a finite number")
+    try:
+        number = float(value)
+    except OverflowError as exc:
+        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a finite number") from exc
+    if not math.isfinite(number):
+        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a finite number")
+    return number
+
+
+class LoadCostProfile:
+    """Decline only an exact measured shape with sufficient predicted savings.
+
+    Costs must compare the same metric, workload and already-issued lookup
+    path. The file's metric labels the objective; it does not change how costs
+    are compared. Unmeasured shapes retain normal loading behavior.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(self, data: dict) -> None:
+        required = {"version", "metric", "profiles"}
+        if not isinstance(data, dict) or not required <= data.keys():
+            raise ValueError("Cost profile requires version, metric and profiles")
+        if data.keys() - required - {"min_savings", "calibration"}:
+            raise ValueError("Unknown cost profile fields")
+        if type(data["version"]) is not int or data["version"] != 1:
+            raise ValueError("Cost profile version must be 1")
+        if data["metric"] not in ("ttft_ms", "request_elapsed_ms", "wave_elapsed_ms"):
+            raise ValueError("Unknown cost profile metric")
+        self.metric = data["metric"]
+        self.min_savings = _number(data.get("min_savings", 0.05), "min_savings")
+        if not 0 <= self.min_savings < 1:
+            raise ValueError("min_savings must be in [0, 1)")
+        rows = data["profiles"]
+        if not isinstance(rows, list) or not rows:
+            raise ValueError("profiles must be a non-empty list")
+        names = {field.name for field in fields(LoadCostKey)}
+        self._costs: dict[LoadCostKey, tuple[float, float]] = {}
+        for row in rows:
+            if not isinstance(row, dict) or row.keys() != names | {
+                "load_ms",
+                "recompute_ms",
+            }:
+                raise ValueError("Each profile must contain exact geometry and costs")
+            if not isinstance(row["model_name"], str) or not row["model_name"]:
+                raise ValueError("model_name must be a non-empty string")
+            for name in names - {"model_name"}:
+                minimum = 0 if name == "engine_computed_tokens" else 1
+                if type(row[name]) is not int or row[name] < minimum:
+                    raise ValueError(f"{name} must be an integer >= {minimum}")
+            if (
+                row["engine_computed_tokens"] + row["external_tokens"]
+                > row["lookup_tokens"]
+            ):
+                raise ValueError("Local and external tokens exceed lookup_tokens")
+            key = LoadCostKey(**{name: row[name] for name in names})
+            if key in self._costs:
+                raise ValueError("Duplicate cost profile geometry")
+            load = _number(row["load_ms"], "load_ms")
+            recompute = _number(row["recompute_ms"], "recompute_ms")
+            if min(load, recompute) <= 0:
+                raise ValueError("Measured costs must be positive")
+            self._costs[key] = (load, recompute)
+
+    @classmethod
+    def from_file(cls, path: str) -> LoadCostProfile:
+        return cls(json.loads(Path(path).read_text(encoding="utf-8")))
+
+    def should_load(self, key: LoadCostKey) -> bool:
+        costs = self._costs.get(key)
+        if costs is None:
+            return True
+        load, recompute = costs
+        return not (recompute < load and recompute <= load * (1 - self.min_savings))

+"""Manual GPU check for LMCache lookup bypass and partial-hit admission.
+
+Install LMCache in the active SGLang environment. Set
+SGLANG_TEST_LMCACHE_TP_SIZE=2 to exercise two ranks.
+"""
+
+import json
+import os
+import socket
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import tempfile
+import time
+import unittest
+import uuid
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import requests
+import torch
+from transformers import AutoTokenizer
+
+from sglang.test.test_utils import (
+    DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_FOR_SERVER_LAUNCH,
+    terminate_and_kill_process_tree,
+)
+from sglang.utils import wait_for_http_ready
+
+
+class TestLMCacheLoadAdmission(unittest.TestCase):
+    @classmethod
+    def setUpClass(cls):
+        cls.tp_size = int(os.environ.get("SGLANG_TEST_LMCACHE_TP_SIZE", "1"))
+        if torch.cuda.device_count() < cls.tp_size:
+            raise unittest.SkipTest(f"Requires {cls.tp_size} GPUs")
+        cls.use_shm = os.environ.get("SGLANG_TEST_LMCACHE_SHM") == "1"
+        cls.use_cost_profile = os.environ.get("SGLANG_TEST_LMCACHE_COST_PROFILE") == "1"
+        cls.model = os.environ.get("SGLANG_TEST_LMCACHE_MODEL", "Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B")
+        port = int(os.environ.get("SGLANG_TEST_LMCACHE_BASE_PORT", "31700"))
+        cls.engine_port = port + 1
+        cls.url = f"http://127.0.0.1:{cls.engine_port}"
+        cls.cache_port, cls.http_port, cls.nccl_port = port + 2, port + 3, port + 4
+        cls.processes = {}
+        directory = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="sglang-lmcache-admission-")
+        cls.addClassCleanup(directory.cleanup)
+        cls.addClassCleanup(cls._stop_all)
+        cls.config = Path(directory.name) / "mp.yaml"
+        cls.cost_profile = Path(directory.name) / "costs.json"
+        # Synthetic costs exercise both branches; these are not calibration data.
+        cls.cost_profile.write_text(
+            json.dumps(
+                {
+                    "version": 1,
+                    "metric": "request_elapsed_ms",
+                    "profiles": [
+                        {
+                            "model_name": cls.model,
+                            "world_size": cls.tp_size,
+                            "chunk_size": 256,
+                            "lookup_tokens": lookup,
+                            "engine_computed_tokens": 0,
+                            "external_tokens": external,
+                            "load_ms": load,
+                            "recompute_ms": recompute,
+                        }
+                        for lookup, external, load, recompute in (
+                            (256, 256, 10, 1),
+                            (1024, 256, 10, 1),
+                            (1024, 1024, 1, 10),
+                        )
+                    ],
+                }
+            ),
+            encoding="utf-8",
+        )
+        cls.config.write_text(
+            f"mp_host: 127.0.0.1\nmp_port: {cls.cache_port}\n"
+            "extra_config:\n  lmcache.mp.mp_transfer_mode: engine_driven\n"
+        )
+        for candidate in range(port + 1, port + 5):
+            with socket.socket() as probe:
+                probe.setsockopt(socket.SOL_SOCKET, socket.SO_REUSEADDR, 1)
+                probe.bind(("127.0.0.1", candidate))
+
+    @classmethod
+    def _stop(cls, name):
+        process = cls.processes.pop(name, None)
+        if process is not None and process.poll() is None:
+            terminate_and_kill_process_tree(process)
+
+    @classmethod
+    def _stop_all(cls):
+        cls._stop("engine")
+        cls._stop("cache")
+
+    @classmethod
+    def _start_cache(cls):
+        command = [
+            sys.executable,
+            "-m",
+            "lmcache.cli.main",
+            "server",
+            "--host",
+            "127.0.0.1",
+            "--port",
+            str(cls.cache_port),
+            "--http-port",
+            str(cls.http_port),
+            "--l1-size-gb",
+            "1",
+            "--chunk-size",
+            "256",
+            "--eviction-policy",
+            "LRU",
+            "--supported-transfer-mode",
+            "engine_driven",
+        ]
+        if cls.use_shm:
+            command += [
+                "--no-l1-use-lazy",
+                "--shm-name",
+                f"sglang_kv_admission_{uuid.uuid4().hex}",
+            ]
+        cls.processes["cache"] = subprocess.Popen(command)
+        deadline = time.monotonic() + 60
+        while time.monotonic() < deadline:
+            if cls.processes["cache"].poll() is not None:
+                raise RuntimeError("LMCache daemon exited during startup")
+            try:
+                with socket.create_connection(("127.0.0.1", cls.cache_port), 1):
+                    return
+            except OSError:
+                time.sleep(0.1)
+        raise TimeoutError("LMCache daemon did not start")
+
+    @classmethod
+    def _start_engine(cls, enable_lmcache):
+        args = [
+            "--tp",
+            str(cls.tp_size),
+            "--nccl-port",
+            str(cls.nccl_port),
+            "--attention-backend",
+            "triton",
+            "--enable-deterministic-inference",
+            "--mem-fraction-static",
+            "0.1",
+            "--max-total-tokens",
+            "8192",
+            "--context-length",
+            "4096",
+            "--disable-cuda-graph",
+        ]
+        if enable_lmcache:
+            args += [
+                "--enable-lmcache",
+                "--lmcache-config-file",
+                str(cls.config),
+                "--lmcache-min-retrieve-tokens",
+                "0" if cls.use_cost_profile else "512",
+            ]
+            if cls.use_cost_profile:
+                args += ["--lmcache-load-cost-profile", str(cls.cost_profile)]
+        cls.processes["engine"] = subprocess.Popen(
+            [
+                sys.executable,
+                "-m",
+                "sglang.launch_server",
+                "--model-path",
+                cls.model,
+                "--host",
+                "127.0.0.1",
+                "--port",
+                str(cls.engine_port),
+                *args,
+            ]
+        )
+        wait_for_http_ready(
+            url=cls.url + "/health",
+            timeout=DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_FOR_SERVER_LAUNCH,
+            process=cls.processes["engine"],
+        )
+
+    def _generate(self, tokens, salt):
+        response = requests.post(
+            self.url + "/generate",
+            json={
+                "input_ids": tokens,
+                "cache_salt": salt,
+                "sampling_params": {
+                    "temperature": 0,
+                    "max_new_tokens": 8,
+                    "ignore_eos": True,
+                },
+            },
+            timeout=180,
+        )
+        response.raise_for_status()
+        result = response.json()
+        self.assertEqual(len(result["output_ids"]), 8)
+        return result
+
+    def _flush(self):
+        requests.post(
+            self.url + "/flush_cache", params={"timeout": 30}, timeout=60
+        ).raise_for_status()
+
+    def _assert_result(self, result, reference, storage_hits):
+        self.assertEqual(result["output_ids"], reference["output_ids"])
+        details = result["meta_info"]["cached_tokens_details"] or {}
+        self.assertEqual(details.get("storage", 0), storage_hits)
+        self.assertEqual(details.get("device", 0), 0)
+
+    def test_bypass_partial_hit_and_reuse_after_recompute(self):
+        tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(self.model)
+        filler = tokenizer.encode("Berlin is the capital of Germany. " * 300)
+        question = tokenizer.encode(
+            "\nWhat is the capital of Germany?\nAnswer:", add_special_tokens=False
+        )
+        long = filler[: 1025 - len(question)] + question
+        short = long[:257]
+        self._start_engine(enable_lmcache=False)
+        short_reference = self._generate(short, "baseline")
+        self._flush()
+        long_reference = self._generate(long, "baseline")
+        if self.use_cost_profile:
+            self._flush()
+            unknown = filler[: 769 - len(question)] + question
+            unknown_reference = self._generate(unknown, "baseline")
+        self._stop("engine")
+        self._start_cache()
+        self._start_engine(enable_lmcache=True)
+
+        self._assert_result(self._generate(short, "partial"), short_reference, 0)
+        self._flush()
+        # The full prompt is above the gate, but only its first chunk exists.
+        self._assert_result(self._generate(long, "partial"), long_reference, 0)
+        self._flush()
+        # Recomputed KV is still stored, and a large enough hit remains usable.
+        self._assert_result(self._generate(long, "partial"), long_reference, 1024)
+        self._flush()
+        self._assert_result(self._generate(short, "partial"), short_reference, 0)
+        self._flush()
+        self._assert_result(self._generate(long, "isolated"), long_reference, 0)
+        if self.use_cost_profile:
+            self._flush()
+            self._assert_result(
+                self._generate(unknown, "unknown"), unknown_reference, 0
+            )
+            self._flush()
+            self._assert_result(
+                self._generate(unknown, "unknown"), unknown_reference, 768
+            )
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()

+def test_store_orders_indices_and_producer_event_on_forward_stream(
+    cache_class, store_raises, device_type
+):
+    cache = cache_class.__new__(cache_class)
+    caller = object()
+    forward = SimpleNamespace(
+        device=torch.device(f"{device_type}:0"), wait_stream=mock.Mock()
+    )
+    active = [caller]
+    sequence = []
+    forward.wait_stream.side_effect = lambda stream: sequence.append(("wait", stream))
+
+    @contextmanager
+    def select(stream):
+        sequence.append(("enter", stream))
+        active.append(stream)
+        try:
+            yield
+        finally:
+            active.pop()
+            sequence.append(("exit", stream))
+
+    def indices(_):
+        assert active[-1] is forward, "GPU indices prepared outside producer stream"
+        sequence.append(("indices", forward))
+        return torch.arange(256)
+
+    def submit(*args, **kwargs):
+        # The connector records the producer event on the current stream.
+        assert device_module.current_stream() is forward
+        sequence.append(("event", forward))
+        if store_raises:
+            raise RuntimeError("store failed")
+        return object()
+
+    cache._forward_stream = forward
+    cache.tree_core = SimpleNamespace(page_size=1, is_eagle=False)
+    cache._mamba_component = None
+    cache._pending_stores = []
+    cache._pending_store_counts = {}
+    cache.path_device_indices = mock.Mock(side_effect=indices)
+    cache.inc_lock_ref = mock.Mock(
+        return_value=SimpleNamespace(to_dec_params=lambda: "lock")
+    )
+    cache.dec_lock_ref = mock.Mock()
+    cache.lmcache_connector = mock.Mock(chunk_size=256)
+    cache.lmcache_connector.get_store_start.return_value = 0
+    cache.lmcache_connector.submit_store.side_effect = submit
+    device_module = SimpleNamespace(
+        current_stream=mock.Mock(side_effect=lambda device=None: active[-1]),
+        stream=mock.Mock(side_effect=select),
+    )
+    req = SimpleNamespace(rid="request", extra_key=None, cache_salt="salt")
+    matched = MatchResult(
+        device_prefix_len=256,
+        last_device_node=7,
+        last_host_node=None,
+        best_match_node=7,
+    )
+    with (
+        mock.patch.object(UnifiedRadixCache, "match_prefix", return_value=matched),
+        mock.patch.object(
+            torch, "get_device_module", return_value=device_module
+        ) as get_device_module,
+        mock.patch.object(
+            torch.cuda,
+            "current_stream",
+            side_effect=AssertionError("Store must use the producer device backend"),
+        ),
+    ):
+        cache._submit_store(req, list(range(256)))
+
+    forward.wait_stream.assert_called_once_with(caller)
+    get_device_module.assert_called_once_with(forward.device)
+    assert active == [caller]
+    assert [name for name, _ in sequence] == [
+        "wait",
+        "enter",
+        "indices",
+        "event",
+        "exit",
+    ]
+    if store_raises:
+        cache.dec_lock_ref.assert_called_once_with(7, "lock")
+        assert not cache._pending_stores
+        assert not cache._pending_store_counts
+    else:
+        cache.dec_lock_ref.assert_not_called()
+        assert len(cache._pending_stores) == 1
+        assert cache._pending_store_counts == {"request": 1}
